{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with 'severe' disease (case-insensitive)
severe_patients = trial_df[trial_df['severity'].str.lower() == 'severe']

# Check the range of biomarker_baseline values
biomarker_min = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].min()
biomarker_max = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].max()

# Print results
print("Range of biomarker_baseline values for severe patients:", biomarker_min, "to", biomarker_max)"}
